description: This file defines the LogWrapper class which implements the LogNode interface. It wraps Android's native Log utility to allow logging to multiple targets, forming a chain of log nodes. The class manages the propagation of log messages, optionally including exception details, to the next node in the chain.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A helper class that wraps Android's native Log utility, implementing LogNode, to facilitate chained logging output and propagate log data to subsequent nodes.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs the message with specified priority, tag, and optional Throwable, then propagates to the next node if available.
